zoe (people-ops): Quick 'self-review microcard' for engineers + managers. Keep 3 lines: Outcome, Evidence (link), Next step. Pasteable.

ian (eng-manager): can you give a KR example that's measurable but not 'vague growth'?

zoe (people-ops): KR example: `KR: Reduce average inference cost per request by 18% (from $0.045 -> $0.037) by EOW Q2 via batching and cache hit improvements. Evidence: dashboard.link/cost, PR#412.`

maya (swe): love the format. Any short copy i can DM folks who missed the deadline?

zoe (people-ops): `Reminder: Hi <name> 1 please add a 1-line focus, 1 evidence link, and 1 next step to your self-review by Friday so I can include it in calibration.`

people-bot: Reminder scheduled 1 DM to managers at 1945678950 and team nudges daily at 09:00 for 4 days. :bell:

ian (eng-manager): i'll push these into my 1:1 agenda and ask for evidence links only. thanks!
